skills.name: Subtract pure fractions with common denominators
skills.definition: Subtract numerator values and keep the common denominator in a pure-fraction subtraction expression once denominators match.

skills.name: Find common denominators and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find an LCD or suitable common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions or fractional parts as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Separate or rewrite operands into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole and common-denominator fractional parts when the fractional difference is nonnegative, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Regroup in mixed or whole number subtraction
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction would be negative, borrow or regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units before subtracting and recombining.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or fractional part to lowest terms.
